rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight powers
fused form with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulaṃ; compound and predicate

items.question: What elements are identified as constituting the root Kaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: The eight powers are named as included.
The attainment of powers is named as included.
These elements are identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The eight powers together with the attainment of powers constitute the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: And the eight powers and the attainment of powers are the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
